title: Message in a Bottle
author: Nicholas Sparks
summary: A divorced newspaper researcher finds a love letter in a bottle on a beach and becomes fascinated by its writer, a widower. She tracks him down on the North Carolina coast, and a relationship begins that she is not fully honest about.
readIf: you like quiet, coastal love stories about grief and starting again, with a good deal of sadness.
skipIf: you want humour or a happy resolution, or you are not drawn to sentimental, slower-paced romance.

pairings.reason: Same author, the same seaside Southern setting and a similar tender, tearful feeling.
Both tell of a mature romance with an aching sense of what might have been.
Another bittersweet romance where grief and hard choices sit close to the love story.
